programme.title: Timothy Bradley vs Manny Pacquiao I

programme.title: Todd Foster vs Jeff Mayweather
programme.desc: On August 6th, 1992 Todd Foster fought Jeff Mayweather at Denton Field in Miles City with Mayweather going down in rounds 7 & 8 the bout resulted in a technical knockout victory for Foster.

programme.title: Tommy Morrison vs George Foreman
programme.desc: On June 7th, 1993 Tommy Morrison battled George Foreman for the WBO world heavyweight title at the Thomas & Mack Center in Las Vegas with Foreman getting a point deducted in round ten the bout resulted in a victory for Morrison.

programme.title: Tyson Fury vs Deontay Wilder 3
programme.desc: On October 9th, 2021, Tyson Fury fought Deontay Wilder in their third and final matchup against each other at T-Mobile Arena in Las Vegas. In a thrilling fight, Fury once again proved his dominance, defeating Wilder by an 11th-round TKO.

programme.title: Tyson Fury vs Dillian Whyte
programme.desc: On April 23rd, 2022 Tyson Fury fought Dillian Whyte for the WBC World Heavyweight title at Wembley Stadium Whyte suffered injuries throughout the fight causing the fight to end by technical knockout in the 4th round giving the bout to Fury.

programme.title: Tyson Fury vs Otto Wallin
programme.desc: On September 14th, 2019, Tyson Fury fought Otto Wallin for the Lineal Heavyweight Championship at T-Mobile Arena in Las Vegas. Despite sustaining a severe cut above his eye early on, Fury prevailed and emerged victorious with an unanimous decision.

programme.title: Tyson Fury vs Tom Schwarz

programme.title: Vasiliy Lomachencko vs Anthony Crolla

programme.title: Vasiliy Lomachenko vs Jorge Linares

programme.title: Vasiliy Lomachenko vs Masayoshi Nakatani

programme.title: Fall
programme.desc: A nail-biting survival thriller. After climbing an abandoned 2000-foot radio tower, best friends Becky and Hunter find themselves trapped at the top with no way down.

programme.title: Safe House
programme.desc: Denzel Washington and Ryan Reynolds must survive the streets of Cape Town in this high energy action film. After a safe house is attacked, a CIA agent must protect his charge.

programme.title: Not My Type
programme.desc: An old-fashioned woman rejects every marriage proposal while waiting for the perfect match. When pressure mounts, she takes matters into her own hands to find the one.

programme.title: Simulant
programme.desc: A thought-provoking sci-fi thriller set in the near future. A humanoid sparks an AI uprising after enlisting a global hacker to remove all restrictions on his thoughts and capabilities.

programme.title: Let Him Go
programme.desc: A star-studded cast leads this book-inspired 1960s Western thriller. A grieving couple tries to reclaim their only grandson, but things quickly spiral out of control.

programme.title: Operation Mincemeat
programme.desc: John Madden brings to life a remarkable true story that shows that all is fair in war. Two British intelligence officers devise a deceptive plan to outwit German troops during WWII.

programme.title: Rango
programme.desc: Gore Verbinski and Johnny Depp (The Pirates of the Caribbean) create an amazing, action-filled animation. A chameleon stuck in a lawless western town becomes its reluctant hero.

programme.title: Mother's Day
programme.desc: The late Garry Marshall directs an ensemble cast in this holiday comedy. Three generations come together in the week leading up to Mother's Day.

programme.title: Couples Retreat
programme.desc: Vince Vaughn and Jon Favreau write and star in this film about marriage. Four couples and a holiday resort are brought face-to-face with the problems in their relationships.

programme.title: Little Fockers
programme.desc: Greg has to prove himself to his father-in-law Jack once more, as he tries to juggle two jobs and two kids.

programme.title: The Croods: A New Age
programme.desc: The all-star cast returns for another prehistoric adventure. This time, the Croods are challenged by a rival family, the Bettermans, who claim to be better and more evolved.

programme.title: Shrek 2
programme.desc: Everyone's favourite ogre returns for another adventure. Newlyweds Fiona and Shrek are invited to visit Fiona's parents in the kingdom of Far Far Away.

programme.title: Wrath Of The Titans
programme.desc: The demigod son of Zeus must leave his peaceful life behind and become a warrior again when his father is kidnapped. He enlists the help of a warrior queen to face Zeus's captors.

programme.title: Hot Seat
programme.desc: Mel Gibson plays a fearless bomb expert in this cyber-thriller. An ex-hacker is forced to break into high-level banking institutions while having a bomb strapped to his chair.

programme.title: Supercell
programme.desc: Fans of Twister will be taken by this danger-filled storm movie. A teenage boy runs away to follow in his father's footsteps, legendary storm chaser Bill Brody.

programme.title: Blacklight
programme.desc: This action thriller finds Liam Neeson and Aidan Quinn on opposite sides of the law. A government operative finds himself in the crosshairs of a man he once helped protect.

programme.title: Bulletproof
programme.desc: Adam Sandler proves his versatility in this buddy action comedy that sees a small-time thief forced to team up with a cop that once betrayed him, played by Damon Wayans.

programme.title: Into The Deep
programme.desc: An intense action thriller. A young woman is swept off her feet by a mysterious stranger who promises her a romantic boat trip. What follows is deceit, mistrust and violence.

programme.title: The Great Wall
programme.desc: Acclaimed filmmaker Yimou Zhang helms this historical fantasy starring Matt Damon. An elite force of warriors must save humanity from a horde of monstrous creatures.

programme.title: Downton Abbey: A New Era
programme.desc: The sequel to the film adaptation of the renowned English TV series. The Crawleys go to the South of France to visit a villa that the Dowager Countess unexpectedly inherits.

programme.title: Headspace
programme.desc: When a team of aliens is stranded in a teenage boy's brain, they must enlist his help to save the Earth from Zolthard, an intergalactic villain who's stuck in the school principal's head.

programme.title: Marmaduke
programme.desc: A fun animated film based on a classic newspaper comic strip. A legendary dog trainer tries to train an undisciplined dog in a bid to turn him into a World Dog Championship contender.

programme.title: Madagascar 3: Europe's Most Wanted
programme.desc: A star-studded voice cast (Ben Stiller, Chris Rock), loads of action, superb visuals and plenty of gags ensure the third attempt by the animals to return to NYC is a win.

programme.title: Flushed Away
programme.desc: This charming animation set in England sees an uptown pet rat being flushed down the toilet and ending up in the sewers of London. He must quickly learn how to survive and adapt.

programme.title: Shrek The Third
programme.desc: Mike Myers and a great cast return for a third instalment to the franchise. After the king falls ill, Shrek, Fiona and friends must defend the kingdom from Prince Charming.

programme.title: Sonic The Hedgehog 2
programme.desc: The electrifying sequel to the hit movie based on the video game. When Dr Robotnik returns to Earth with a new ally, Knuckles, Sonic and his new friend Tails must stop them.

programme.title: Marry Me
programme.desc: Jennifer Lopez and Owen Wilson are thrown together in this heart-warming, crazy rom-com. A pop star marries a stranger from the audience after being betrayed by her fianc.

programme.title: The Scorpion King
programme.desc: Dwayne Johnson takes his Scorpion King character from 'The Mummy Returns' into its own adventure in this spin-off film about a desert warrior trying to oust a ruthless tyrant.

programme.title: Skyscraper
programme.desc: Dwayne Johnson puts his body on the line in this heart-thumping action film. A security expert infiltrates a burning skyscraper when his family is taken hostage.

programme.title: Night Of The Hunted
programme.desc: An intense cat-and-mouse thriller. A woman finds herself the target of a crazy sniper with a secret vendetta after she stops at a remote gas station.

programme.title: Doomsday
programme.desc: A fatal virus spreads through Britain and is contained by quarantining the country. When it resurfaces years later, a specialist is called in to retrieve a cure through a now-savage land.

programme.title: The Flyboys
programme.desc: Two boys from a small town find their courage tested when they accidentally stow away aboard an airplane owned by the mob.

programme.title: Split
programme.desc: Three girls must escape their kidnapper diagnosed with 23 distinct personalities, before a bloody 24th personality emerges.

programme.title: Watchmen: Chapter I
programme.desc: The murder of a government-sponsored superhero draws Rorschach out of retirement, leading him to uncover a conspiracy that threatens global peace.
